decisions.reason: Report cites running-processes.txt and names the dsh web host node.exe PID 42432 as the process that loaded koffi.node at startup, explaining the OS keeps the loaded native image locked until the host exits so npm's copyfile fails with EBUSY.

Explains a browser refresh only reloads the SPA while the server-side host owning the native module stays alive, and gives an ordered stop dsh, verify with tasklist, install, verify version, restart procedure restricted to dsh-related processes, not all node.exe.

Grounded in npm-dist-tags.txt: an unversioned global install follows the latest tag, which points to 0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha points to 0.1.2-alpha.5, so the unpinned command replaced installed alpha.4 with rc.2 instead of preserving or upgrading it.

Gives the exact pinned combined command npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui after stopping the host, verifies dsh --version prints alpha.5, and restarts; @alpha is only noted as a mutable alternative, not a replacement.

Advises README authors to pin the exact core version in every package of combined install commands, avoid relying on implicit latest over existing prereleases, and add stop/verify steps to upgrade docs.
